svg.title: Excel XLOOKUP·VLOOKUP #N/A errors: Check the lookup value first, then handle blanks
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Excel XLOOKUP·VLOOKUP #N/A errors: Check the lookup
value first, then handle blanks
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-29
Check whether the lookup value
actually exists in the source range
The most common cause is that the lookup value
does not exist in the source data.
Match number and text formats and
remove spaces
If the lookup value is a number but the value in
the source table is stored as text, the two
values may not be recognized as equal, resulting…
Confirm that the lookup is for an
exact match
If the last argument of VLOOKUP is TRUE or
omitted, it attempts to find an approximate
match when no exactly matching value exists.
Display a value only for rows that are
legitimately missing
If an item is legitimately absent from the list,
it is better to define the result in advance
than to hide the error.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
